text:
sam (CEO): quick follow-up from the Q&A in today's all-hands. trying a slightly different format: paste one short anecdote (win or loss), one explicit blocker, and one tiny next-step we can ship in <2 weeks. thanks.

luke (All-hands host): dropping this thread for concise follow-ups. pls be brief.

maya (VP Sales): anecdote: won a mid-market analytics deal after showing predictable burst pricing for seasonal spikes. blocker: customers ask 'what happens to cost if we double throughput' and we don't have a simple calculator. next-step: Sales+RevOps to draft a one-slide cost-explainer + a lightweight calc spreadsheet.

alice (Customer Success): anecdote: onboarding templates cut integration time to prod from 7 days to 2 for one retailer. blocker: customers hit inconsistent output formatting after model updates. next-step: CS+Product to add a "expected-output samples" attachment to every POC and run a single regression test pre-update.

jorge (Product): anecdote: multiple prospects asked for explicit IdP/SCIM examples. blocker: our docs show general SSO but no SCIM mappings. next-step: product to publish a SCIM sample mapping and a short compatibility note for top 3 IdPs.

ravi (Eng): anecdote: an SE showed a demo where routing fallback gracefully reduced latency — big win. blocker: some model variants still exceed KV cache under long context bursts causing edge timeouts. next-step: enable an automatic routing guard for bursty sessions and emit a metric; PR ready for review.

tanya (Solutions): anecdote: lost a live retail POC because we couldn't demo deterministic fallback for hallucinations in 10 minutes. blocker: SEs lack a compact demo script that highlights mitigation. next-step: Solutions will draft a 6-min demo script + one-slide cheat-sheet for execs.

ben (Legal): anecdote: enterprise buyers immediately ask for SLA wording. blocker: no small-template SLA for pilots. next-step: Legal to draft a minimal pilot SLA + a data-residency addendum and post to the shared drive.

elena (RevOps): ops request: please drop anonymized one-line loss reasons in the shared folder with a standardized "why_lost" tag; i'll update Salesforce picklist to include the new options.

ops-bot: follow-up doc created: https://internal/docs/allhands/debrief-compact. add your one-liners.

sam (CEO): this is excellent. prioritize shipping those tiny docs and script artifacts. pragmatic wins first. if anyone needs a quick budget or a legal review slot, ping me.

luke (All-hands host): i'll collate items, add owners and deadlines, and post the checklist by EOD tomorrow. please keep your follow-ups to single lines in that doc. thanks! :white_check_mark:
file_notes: Compact all-hands follow-up: each participant lists a short anecdote, a blocker, and a <2-week next-step. Anonymous customer items requested and owners assigned. No title field as per agents.md.
